texts.wy_age_note: Ntidusaba na rimwe itariki y'amavuko yawe.
texts.wy_alert_note: Kwinjira uvuye ku gikoresho gishya cyangwa ahantu hashya byohereza integuza ku bikoresho byawe byose, hamwe na Si jye.
texts.wy_app_lock: Gusaba igikumwe cyanjye cyangwa isura yanjye kugira ngo porogaramu ifunguke
texts.wy_auth_note: Porogaramu yose isanzwe yo kwemeza ikora. Soma kode cyangwa wandike urufunguzo, hanyuma wandike imibare 6 igaragaza.
texts.wy_basic_limits: Iyi konti yafunguriwe kuri telefone isanzwe. Ongeraho imeli kugira ngo ukoreshe kwakira amafaranga, amakarita, kuvunja no kugurisha mu iduka ryo kuri interineti.
texts.wy_blocked: Wagerageje kenshi cyane. Mu minsi 7 iyi konti yemera gusa imfunguzo zo kwinjira n'imfunguzo z'umutekano.
texts.wy_check_second_way: Ongeraho uburyo bwa kabiri bwo kwinjira
texts.wy_code_note: Kode imara iminota 5 kandi ikora kuri iki gikoresho gusa.
texts.wy_codes_none_left: Nta kode y'ingoboka isigaye. Kora inshya.
texts.wy_contacts_note: Abantu 3 kugeza kuri 5 wizera. Nubura ibikoresho byawe byose, babiri muri bo bemeza ko ari wowe.
texts.wy_country_lock_note: Emera kwinjira bivuye mu bihugu wahisemo gusa. Ntugire icyo wandika kugira ngo wemere ibihugu byose.
texts.wy_country_note: Igihugu cyawe kigena ururimi, ifaranga na serivisi zigaragara mbere. Ushobora kugihindura nyuma.
texts.wy_email_note: Twohereza kode kuri iyi meli. Konti yawe ikenera imeli na nimero ya telefone.
texts.wy_extra_note: Uku kwinjira ni gushya cyangwa ntikusanzwe, ni yo mpamvu dusaba irindi genzura.
texts.wy_keys_note: Urufunguzo rwa USB cyangwa urwo gukoza rukora nk'urufunguzo rwo kwinjira.
texts.wy_legal_no_digits: Izina ryemewe ntirigira imibare. Ryandike nk'uko riri ku ndangamuntu yawe.
texts.wy_legal_note: Ryandike uko riri ku ndangamuntu yawe. Rigumana ibanga kandi rikoreshwa gusa iyo igenzura rikeneye izina ryawe nyakuri. Izina rigaragara rishobora kuba ritandukanye.
texts.wy_legal_too_long: Izina ryemewe ni rirerire cyane. Rigabanye rigere ku nyuguti 100 cyangwa munsi.
texts.wy_legal_too_short: Izina ryemewe ni rigufi cyane. Andika izina ryawe ryose nk'uko riri ku ndangamuntu yawe.
texts.wy_lock_first: Banza ufunge byose: buri gihe cyo kwinjira kirarangira, amakarita arasabirwa guhagarikwa kandi imfunguzo zirahagarara.
texts.wy_locked: Byafunzwe. Ubu ongera winjire hanyuma urebe ibikorwa by'umutekano.
texts.wy_lost_done: Niba amakuru yahuye, konti yawe ubu irafunze.
texts.wy_lost_note: Funga konti yawe utinjiye. Koresha kode y'ingoboka cyangwa kode yawe yo kugarura.
texts.wy_offline_signup: Jya kuri interineti kugira ngo ufungure konti yawe. Ibyo wanditse birabikwa.
texts.wy_org_note: Kuri Max na Enterprise: imfunguzo z'umutekano ku ba nyir'ubucuruzi n'abayobozi, igihe abakozi bamara binjiye n'ibikoresho by'ikigo gusa.
texts.wy_passkey_note: Urufunguzo rwo kwinjira rukwinjiza ukoresheje igikumwe, isura cyangwa ifunga rya ekarani. Nta jambobanga ryo kwibuka cyangwa kwibwa.
texts.wy_phone_note: Twohereza kode kuri iyi nimero. Iyo nimero yonyine ntijya ifungura cyangwa igarura konti yawe.
texts.wy_po_act_first_paid_offer: Itangwa ryawe rya mbere ryishyurwa kuri Storefront
texts.wy_po_consent: Nemeye kohereza izina ryanjye ryemewe n'inimero yanjye ku muyoboro wanjye wa telefone kuri iri genzura.
texts.wy_po_free: Iri genzura ni ubuntu kuri wowe. Izina umuyoboro ufite ntirigaragazwa kandi ntiribikwa.
texts.wy_po_id_doc: Umuyoboro wawe wa telefone ntaratanga iri genzura hano, bityo umufatanyabikorwa wacu wemewe ugenzura indangamuntu yawe aho.
texts.wy_po_match: Inimero yawe yemejwe ko ari iyawe. Bimara iminsi {n}, cyangwa kugeza inimero cyangwa SIM yawe ihindutse.
texts.wy_po_network: Umuyoboro wawe wa telefone ugereranya izina ryawe ryemewe n'inimero yawe.
texts.wy_po_no_match: Umuyoboro wawe uvuga ko iyi nimero itanditse ku izina ryawe.
texts.wy_po_note: Ni ku bikenera nyir'inimero nyakuri gusa. Ntibikoreshwa mu kwinjira kwa buri munsi.
texts.wy_po_partial: Izina ryawe rihuye igice gusa n'iryo umuyoboro wawe ufite.
texts.wy_po_wait: SIM yawe yahinduwe vuba. Kugira ngo konti yawe irindwe, ibi bitegereza kugeza {when}.
texts.wy_po_wait_how: Nta cyo ukora. Icyo gihe tuzongera kubaza umuyoboro.
texts.wy_po_who: LynkOmni ntijya yishyura iri genzura. Umufatanyabikorwa wemewe w'iyi serivisi arikora mu igenzura rye, cyangwa uryasabye akaryishyura.
texts.wy_po_why: Banza ushyire akamenyetso mu gasanduku kari hejuru.
texts.wy_privacy_screen: Guhisha amafaranga n'amazina iyo ekarani yanjye isangiwe
texts.wy_problem_someone_else: Undi muntu ari muri konti yanjye
texts.wy_qr_note: Fungura LynkOmni kuri telefone yawe yinjiye hanyuma usome iyi kode. Ikora rimwe kandi irangira nyuma y'iminota 2.
texts.wy_recover_lead: LynkOmni nta majambobanga igira. Tubwire ikibazo maze tukwereke uburyo bwo kugaruka ufite.
texts.wy_recovery_note: Andika kode yo kugarura ku rupapuro uyibike mu rugo. Bika kode 10 z'ingoboka ahantu hizewe. Zigaragazwa rimwe gusa.
texts.wy_remember_note: Kuri mudasobwa isangiwe, ntubihitemo: uzasohorwa nyuma y'amasaha 12.
texts.wy_restricted: Mu masaha 24: nta kwakira amafaranga, guhindura uburyo bwo kwishyurwa, kuramo, guhindura amakarita cyangwa aho uboneka.
texts.wy_step_recovery: Kode yawe yo kugarura na kode z'ingoboka
texts.wy_stopped: Byahagaritswe. Mu gihe runaka tuzajya dusaba irindi genzura igihe cyose winjiye.
texts.wy_strongest_note: Imfunguzo zo kwinjira n'iz'umutekano gusa. Nta kode kuri imeli cyangwa ubutumwa bugufi. Impinduka zitegereza iminsi 7.
texts.wy_too_many: Konti nyinshi cyane zafunguriwe hano mu isaha ishize. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'isaha imwe.
texts.wy_turn_off_note: Guhagarika igenzura bisaba irindi genzura rishya no gutegereza igihe cy'umutekano kirangire.
texts.wy_unusual_impossible_journey: Ibihugu bibiri byegeranye cyane mu gihe
texts.wy_waiting_note: Twamenyesheje buri gikoresho n'umuntu bya konti yawe. Uwo ari we wese ashobora kubihagarika akanze rimwe.
texts.wy_way_authenticator: Kode iturutse kuri porogaramu yo kwemeza
texts.wy_way_contacts_note: Dusaba abantu bagufasha kugarura konti kwemeza ko ari wowe. Babiri bagomba kwemeza.
texts.wy_way_email_and_phone: Kode kuri imeli yanjye no kuri telefone yanjye
texts.wy_way_id_note: Umufatanyabikorwa wemewe agenzura indangamuntu yawe na nimero yawe ya telefone. Abakozi babiri ba LynkOmni barabyemeza.
texts.wy_way_other_device_note: Fungura LynkOmni ku gikoresho kicyinjiye hanyuma wemeze.
texts.wy_who_label: Izina ukoresha, imeli cyangwa nimero ya telefone
texts.wy_word_note: Ijambo ryawe ry'ibanga riboneka muri buri imeli n'ubutumwa nyakuri bya LynkOmni. Ubutumwa butarimo iryo jambo ntibuturutse kuri twe.
texts.wy_word_rule: Inyuguti, imibare cyangwa imyanya biri hagati ya 3 na 30, mu rurimi urwo ari rwo rwose. Inyuguti nkuru n'into zibikwa uko wazanditse neza.
